question: How much of the rejected compact full-replacement 5TPP gap is caused by the compact full MLP when attention V and output remain dense?

causal_authorization.frozen_failure_branch: localize attention V versus attention output under the same Pair-VQ full-MLP parent; do not alter the MLP or scale

held_compact: headwise Q/K BlockFHT with output gain
all MLP c_fc and c_proj matrices using the qualified Pair-VQ codec
changed_from_rejected_full_replacement: disable Pair-VQ for attention V and attention output only

performance_gate.method: foreground exact-config real optimizer updates through examples.nanogpt.mfu_preflight

forbidden: changing the MLP codec during this attribution
interpreting a 0.5TPP result as a 5TPP control
